confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderate confidence. Accommodation anchors are lower confidence because July is peak season and prices vary widely by property and date. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine glass about 1.4x beer), not from direct price knowledge. FX provenance: the 0.6947 USD per AUD value for 2026-10-16 came from a third-party site that describes it as the RBA indicative mid-point. I did not open the rba.gov.au page, so the figure is unverified against the official RBA table, and the source_url is the RBA exchange rates page that should be checked. A 2026-10-15 RBA homepage snippet showed 0.6955, but its labels were jumbled, so I did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on comparable Adriatic coastal tourist towns, mainly Split and Budva, with Kotor priced slightly below Dubrovnik in July. Montenegro uses the euro, so prices were estimated in EUR and converted to USD at roughly 1.15 USD per EUR.
